summary: Frontend-only verification of the shared 'Quick Edit Product' modal across all Manager pages. The new QuickEditProductDrawer correctly wraps the same QuickEditModal used on /admin/supplier-products, so every Manager (Materials, Tiles, Flooring, Bathroom, UFH, Custom/Grout-Sealants) now opens the SAME modal — title 'Quick Edit Product', with Customer-Facing (Display Name + auto-generated Display Code), Internal (Supplier Product Name + Supplier Product Code), List/Cost Price, Stock (units + m²), Featured toggle, and Product Images upload area. The removed material-specific fields (Bag Colour, Coverage m²/bag, Setting Time) do NOT appear inside the modal on any page. Save-path round-trip works: on SKU 355POL6060 the display_name was changed to 'TEST-QE-Verify-8447' → success toast → modal closed → list refreshed → reopening the modal showed the new value (persisted) → restored to original 'Premium Polished Porcelain 60x60'. Regression on /admin/supplier-products (pencil-icon Quick Edit) still opens the same modal (verified in screenshot). Series-grouping regression: search=Dolomite renders the 'Dolomite Onyx Series — 23 products' banner as expected.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Need more options? Open full editor' link inside the shared modal calls onEditFullPage(product) but the drawer never receives/passes this prop from ManagerPageShell → clicking it will throw a runtime TypeError. Not exercised in current tests but a latent bug.
ui_bugs.selector: text=Need more options? Open full editor

issues: Stale 'How this page works' hint copy still says things like 'Click Edit — only UFH-relevant fields show (coverage m², voltage, W/m², thermostat)' or 'only tile-relevant fields show' but the modal is now the SHARED Quick Edit Product modal with no category-specific fields. Hint copy should be updated to reflect the new unified experience.
Console a11y warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} — should add DialogDescription for screen readers.
React 'unique key' warning in render (pre-existing, non-blocking)

per_page_verification.materials: PASS — title, Customer-Facing, Internal, Display Name/Code, Supplier Name/Code, List/Cost Price, Stock, Product Images area all visible; Bag Colour / Coverage m² / Setting Time absent from modal.
per_page_verification.underfloor_heating: PASS — modal is clean (no Coverage m² inside dialog). The word 'coverage m²' does appear on the page but ONLY in the stale hint text OUTSIDE the modal.
per_page_verification.tools: NOT-EXERCISED — Tools Manager currently has 0 products, so no Edit button rows to click. Same shell code path used as other managers so it should behave identically once products exist.
per_page_verification.supplier_products_regression: PASS — pencil-icon Quick Edit still opens the same Quick Edit Product modal (screenshot confirmed).
per_page_verification.series_grouping_regression: PASS — Dolomite search shows 'Dolomite Onyx Series 23 products' banner.

action_items: Pass an `onEditFullPage` handler from ManagerPageShell into <QuickEditProductDrawer> (or hide the 'Open full editor' link when the callback is missing) to prevent a TypeError when a user clicks it inside a Manager page.
Update the 'How this page works' hint copy on every Manager page — remove the promise that Edit shows only category-specific fields, since the shared Quick Edit modal is now used everywhere.
Add a `<DialogDescription>` inside QuickEditModal to silence the a11y aria-describedby warning.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickEditProductDrawer is a nicely isolated ~250-line wrapper — clean separation of state vs presentation.
QuickEditModal still references `onEditFullPage` (line ~476) which is a hard runtime dependency; the drawer must supply it OR the modal must guard against undefined.

onImageUpload uses `product._id` for the FormData, but the save handler falls back to `product.sku || product.supplier_code || product._id` — Manager pages primarily use `sku`; confirm that upload endpoint accepts sku-based product_id or images may not associate correctly on non-supplier-products managers. Not exercised in this run.
displayCodePreview endpoint uses a plain fetch with no auth header while quick-update uses none either — consistent but worth confirming these endpoints are truly public.
Category suggestions endpoint fires on every modal open — could be cached at the Shell level to avoid a network call per Edit click.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all pages tested (6/6 manager pages with products + regression paths); Tools not exercised (0 products)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing SKU 355POL6060 and restored display_name to 'Premium Polished Porcelain 60x60' after test.

Modal DialogTitle text = 'Quick Edit Product'. Tools Manager has 0 products so Edit-click flow cannot be validated there. On /admin/supplier-products the Edit control is a pencil icon (svg.lucide-pen-line) inside each row — button testids follow pattern quick-edit-{SKU} / edit-{SKU} (the 'edit-{SKU}' testid redirects to the Tiles Manager; the 'quick-edit-{SKU}' one opens the modal). Do NOT confuse the two.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regression found. The main risk left is the latent TypeError from the 'Open full editor' link in the shared modal when opened from any Manager page (drawer doesn't pass onEditFullPage).
